candidate: H36a shared 146-stage full-coverage Givens task-atom fit-all capacity discriminator
purpose: Test whether an exact one-percent shared orientation-only transform that rotates every hidden and residual channel can fit the six known leading-PC parts when applied to a basis-free task-gradient atom.

task_atom.formula: D_n(E) = NS5(gradient of fixed task loss with respect to W_n at W0)
task_atom.left_transport: Q_L = product over 146 procedurally permuted full-coverage disjoint Givens layers
task_atom.right_transport: Q_R = product over 146 procedurally permuted full-coverage disjoint Givens layers

fit.target: six-node leading PC of the centered registered 239-state trajectory
fit.normalization: unit Frobenius norm independently for every task atom and PC part
fit.algorithm: 64 deterministic full-batch Adam iterations maximizing mean smooth absolute cosine
fit.node_coefficients: post-fit optimal signed scalar; charged but not needed by the cosine optimizer

routing_after_pass: Write and preregister H36b using the identical stages, prompt, permutations, initialization, optimizer, and state for six-fold leave-one-node-out transfer.
routing_after_failure: Close the exact shared full-coverage orthogonal task-atom family and analyze a non-orthogonal full-rank successor before code.
